watch.text: Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (ankle surgery), Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Nikola Topic and Thomas Sorber are out vs NO 11/20; Alex Caruso (hip) is questionable.
Dejounte Murray (ankle), Trendon Watford and Bennedict Mathurin are out at OKC 11/20; Trey Murphy III (knee tendinopathy) is questionable after missing recent games.
C Alperen Sengun (32.8 mpg) has a corneal abrasion from 11/18 vs IND and is questionable at DEN; Clint Capela (ankle) is out and Steven Adams (quad) questionable.
G CJ McCollum (26.4 mpg, calf) is out at least four weeks as of 11/17; Kingston Flemings (back) and Jock Landale (hip) also sat 11/18 at OKC.
C Evan Mobley (32 mpg, toe sprain) is out and re-evaluated in 7-10 days; Peyton Watson (back) and Jaylon Tyson (ankle) sat 11/18 vs MEM, day-to-day.
G Cade Cunningham (35 mpg, knee) missed 11/18 vs NO and is day-to-day; F Duncan Robinson (30.6 mpg, quad) is out about a week.
G Austin Reaves (35 mpg, heel) remains out with no return timetable as of 11/19; JJ Redick said his pregame workout went well.
RJ Barrett (hamstring) and Scottie Barnes (injury management) both sat 11/18 vs WSH and are day-to-day; Collin Murray-Boyles left that game ill.
G Andrew Nembhard (33.4 mpg, hip) sat 11/18 vs HOU and is day-to-day; Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) still has no return timetable.

401909310.summary: OKC is without Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Wallace and Topic (Caruso questionable), which plausibly covers most of our 3-point gap; NO is also short Murray, with Murphy questionable.

reasons.text: OKC rules out Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace, Nikola Topic and Thomas Sorber; Alex Caruso is questionable with a new hip issue.
NO is without Dejounte Murray, Bennedict Mathurin and Trendon Watford; Trey Murphy III is questionable (knee tendinopathy).
The market hasn't moved from its open (OKC -11.5).

returning.text: Questionable after missing recent games with knee tendinopathy.

401909312.summary: Sengun is a coin flip with an eye injury and HOU is thin at center (Capela out, Adams questionable) while DEN is healthy; that covers part of our 3.9-point gap.

reasons.text: C Alperen Sengun is questionable with a left-eye corneal abrasion from 11/18; Ime Udoka was unsure he'd play because the eye was swollen.
HOU also has Clint Capela (ankle) out and Steven Adams (quad) questionable, leaving little center depth.
DEN's report is nearly clean (Jokic not listed; Julian Strawther out). We've been lower than the market on DEN in 5 of 6 games; no injury reason found for that.

swings.HOU: Alperen Sengun left 11/18 vs IND with an eye injury (corneal abrasion) and is questionable at DEN; Capela is also out (FanSided, 11/20).

swings.CLE: C Evan Mobley (32 mpg) went out with a toe sprain, re-evaluated in 7-10 days (ESPN, 11/19); the line has dropped from CLE -7.5 at open to -5.5.

swings.CHA: Nothing found: the market moved on CHA without a clear reason.
